posts.author: avinash007
posts.community: Protean EGov Technologies Ltd - A Play on the ONDC, Digital Policies
posts.text: I had same question when I looked at low PAT margins. 50% rev comes from PAN card and related services,(though decreasing with new offerings coming in) sticky business but growth is not there. India has approx 70-75 cr PAN cards with some 60 cr linked to aadhar. This should cover the total tax paying population so not much growth in terms of new cards there. They seem like service/product kind of business but margin (PAT) are thin at 10%. With more ASK outlets the margin is not going to improve. Other services include data and identity like aadhar verification , pension schemes management like…

posts.text: recent regulatory cap on intermediary fees by IRDAI had impacted insurance distributors’ stocks like PBFINTECH & banks, however this is beneficial for DPI like BIMA SUGAM, a insurance marketplace contract which Protean won in 2025 for implementation & maintenance(100 Cr. for 6 years, 17 Cr./annum rev.) I think the recent surge maybe due to the possible potential gain for Protean like transaction-based fees & value-add identity/verification services such as eKYC, e-signPRO,etc, financial impact is unknown yet.
